Method:-
Wash and dry pork roast.
Season with salt, pepper, garlic, and onions.
Sprinkle top, bottom, and sides thoroughly with soy sauce.
Cover and bake for 2 to 2 1/2 hours in a preheated 325°F/Gas Mark 3 or 4 oven.
Spread marmalade on top,and bake uncovered for 30-40 more minutes.
